question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An outlook that is influenced by people from all over the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **Cosmopolitan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cosmopolitan:** containing people from all over the world.

 
 
• ***Example***: London is a** cosmopolitan** city. 
 
 
 
• Thus, **the correct answer** is **option 1.**

Thus, the one-word substitute for the given group of words is **Cosmopolitan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Epitome: **a perfect example of something.
 
• **Unrefined: **not processed to remove impurities or unwanted elements.
 
• **Cantonment: **a military garrison or camp.
